metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Like Community and Ted Lasso, this features a lovable ensemble cast and an incredibly uplifting, optimistic tone.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Matches the fast-paced, witty ensemble dynamic of Scrubs and New Girl while remaining lighthearted.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A perfect comfort show that evolves from sharp comedy into a deeply heartwarming story, similar to Ted Lasso.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Combines the surreal comedy of Rick and Morty with a mockumentary style that fits your love for unique sitcoms.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A British cult classic that aligns with Peep Show's humor and Silicon Valley's tech-centric comedy.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: Directed by Edgar Wright, this surreal British sitcom shares the pop-culture obsession and meta-humor of Community.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Features the high-density joke writing seen in The Simpsons and Futurama, set in a chaotic workplace.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A wholesome but hilarious animated family sitcom that serves as a modern spiritual successor to King of the Hill.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the Rick and Morty team, it offers the same sci-fi absurdity and high-concept animation you enjoy.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: An adult animated comedy with sharp dialogue and meta-jokes that fans of Arrested Development and Rick and Morty will love.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, it blends spectacular action with a touching and funny coming-of-age story.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: Often compared to New Girl, it's a fast-paced 'friends in the city' sitcom with an incredible comedic energy.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Created by the Always Sunny team, it captures the workplace dysfunction of Silicon Valley within the gaming industry.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: The quintessential 'background' comfort show with iconic characters and legendary comedic timing.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A light, easy-to-watch mockumentary that provides consistent laughs and feel-good family moments.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A charming ensemble workplace comedy that feels like a spiritual cousin to Scrubs and Parks and Rec.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A hilarious and heartwarming 'rom-com' adventure that matches the quirky, genre-bending energy of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A lighthearted 'blue skies' detective show with a bromance and pop-culture references reminiscent of Scrubs.

metas.name: Friday Night Dinner
metas.description: A chaotic British sitcom focusing on family dynamics, perfect for fans of Peep Show and Brassic.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: From the creators of Peep Show, this follows university students with the same awkward, cringe-inducing humor.

metas.name: Toast of London
metas.description: Matt Berry stars in this absurd British comedy that matches the eccentric humor of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: A legendary British comedy about the awkwardness of youth, fitting well with your interest in Peep Show.

metas.name: Good Omens
metas.description: A fantastical, witty, and lighthearted adventure that aligns with the sci-fi/fantasy vibes of Doctor Who.

metas.name: Upload
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy about the afterlife that blends the conceptual depth of The Good Place with a lighthearted mystery.

metas.name: Avenue 5
metas.description: A space-set satire from the creator of Veep that appeals to fans of Futurama and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A love letter to Star Trek that balances sci-fi adventure with the humor found in Futurama.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A wholesome, funny, and beautifully animated show that appeals to fans of lighthearted action like One Piece.

metas.name: Harley Quinn
metas.description: A chaotic, R-rated animated comedy with the same irreverent energy and meta-humor as Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult classic workplace comedy with a revolving door of guests, similar in vibe to Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Features some of the sharpest, fastest insults in TV history, appealing to fans of Silicon Valley and Peep Show.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: From the makers of Ted Lasso, it balances heavy life themes with hilarious, comforting ensemble comedy.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A heartwarming mockumentary that has quickly become a gold standard for comfort TV and ensemble laughs.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A delightful British sitcom about a couple living with ghosts, offering great background comfort and quirky humor.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A hilarious and heartwarming look at teenage life in 90s Northern Ireland, perfect for fans of Brassic.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A very easy-to-watch, funny, and heartwarming family sitcom that provides great background comfort.

metas.name: Review
metas.description: A dark but hilarious conceptual comedy that fans of Nathan for You and Always Sunny will find brilliant.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: A surreal mock-docuseries that pushes social awkwardness to the limit, much like the best moments of Peep Show.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Known for its layered callbacks and meta-humor, it is the blueprint for many shows like Community.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A short-lived but brilliant corporate satire that matches the wit and pacing of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A classic British 'misanthrope' comedy that fits perfectly with Peep Show and the dry humor of The IT Crowd.
